disagreement_analysis: The qwen model returned 'inconclusive' due to an HTTP 400 API error while reviewing a LICENSE file. Per the rules, a report ending in a tool error carries no verdict signal and is treated as missing. The deepseek model successfully reviewed all files and correctly identified the package as safe. The openrouter model is advisory and also found it safe, providing corroborating context.
coverage_issues: The qwen model failed to audit one of the LICENSE files due to an HTTP 400 BadRequestError, resulting in an inconclusive package verdict.
learnings: Transient API errors on trivial, non-executable files (like LICENSE) should not cascade to an 'inconclusive' package verdict; the tool should either retry, ignore non-executable file failures, or allow partial verdicts.
The audit tool appears to be submitting the same file (LICENSE) multiple times to the models, leading to redundant API calls and increasing the chance of transient failures.
